entries.title: Katana ZERO

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is one of the original launch platforms, has native PC capture/settings flexibility, and avoids the mobile touch-control compromise noted for the Netflix mobile ports. The large free DLC is still documented as upcoming with no release date, so the current PC build is the complete playable route for now.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Katana ZERO on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build; add the free DLC later only after it is actually released.

entries.remaster_caveats: A large free DLC is still announced as coming and still free, but has no released build/date in the cited public sources; update this entry after release.
